# TGProxy Panel

> Open-source, self-hosted control panel for your own Telegram proxy nodes. Русский и English.

Canonical website: https://tgproxypanel.com/
Source repository: https://github.com/greenpandorik/tgproxy-panel
License: AGPL-3.0. The software is free; operators supply their own VPS hosts and domains.

TGProxy Panel manages users, proxy secrets, subscription pages, limits, cover websites,
monitoring, backups and updates. telemt serves Fake-TLS, WEB proxy traffic and cover websites.
Legacy tproxy-server nodes remain supported. The panel and proxy nodes run on separate hosts;
user proxy traffic goes through the nodes, not through the panel.

## Public guides

- [Project overview — Русский](https://tgproxypanel.com/): purpose, features and installation entry point.
- [Project overview — English](https://tgproxypanel.com/en/): English overview and installation entry point.
- [Установка панели и telemt](https://tgproxypanel.com/guides/install-telemt/): VPS, DNS, firewall ports, node registration, users and checks.
- [Install the panel and telemt](https://tgproxypanel.com/en/guides/install-telemt/): English installation and connection checklist.
- [MTProxy, Fake-TLS и WEB](https://tgproxypanel.com/guides/mtproxy-faketls-web/): protocols, masking domains, links and client compatibility.
- [MTProxy, Fake-TLS and WEB](https://tgproxypanel.com/en/guides/mtproxy-faketls-web/): English protocol comparison and usage guidance.

## Management API

- [API — Русский](https://tgproxypanel.com/api/): персональные Bearer-токены, разрешения, примеры curl и Python, пагинация и ошибки.
- [API — English](https://tgproxypanel.com/en/api/): personal Bearer tokens, scope/role intersection, examples, queued changes and endpoint catalog.
- [OpenAPI 3.0.3](https://tgproxypanel.com/api/openapi.json): downloadable route contract generated from the backend's explicit personal-token policy.
- [API guide — Русский](https://github.com/greenpandorik/tgproxy-panel/blob/main/docs/api.ru.md)
- [API guide — English](https://github.com/greenpandorik/tgproxy-panel/blob/main/docs/api.md)

API requests go to the operator's own installed panel at https://<panel-domain>/api/v1,
not to tgproxypanel.com. Token access is the intersection of its scopes and the account's
current role. Token management, account security, administrators, backups and subscription-service
credentials require a browser session. Agent, probe, metrics and subscription-service credentials
remain separate from personal tokens.

- [Full setup — Русский](https://github.com/greenpandorik/tgproxy-panel/blob/main/docs/setup.ru.md)
- [Full setup — English](https://github.com/greenpandorik/tgproxy-panel/blob/main/docs/setup.en.md)

- [Reference — English](https://github.com/greenpandorik/tgproxy-panel/blob/main/docs/reference.md)
- [Troubleshooting — Русский](https://github.com/greenpandorik/tgproxy-panel/blob/main/docs/runbook.ru.md)
- [Troubleshooting — English](https://github.com/greenpandorik/tgproxy-panel/blob/main/docs/runbook.md)
- [Releases](https://github.com/greenpandorik/tgproxy-panel/releases): current published versions and changes.
- [telemt source](https://github.com/telemt/telemt): engine-specific behavior and compatibility.

Client support and engine versions can change. Check current project documentation and releases
before making version-specific claims. A reachable HTTPS cover site alone does not prove that
an authenticated proxy can reach Telegram. Masking does not guarantee access from every network.
